transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... my brain just feels like it stalls out. I'll sit at work with a test report or even just a simple CAD note open for an hour, and... I just can't decide what the next sentence should be. Or which checkbox to click. I just... sit there.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really... thought about it like that. I guess I just feel... I don't know. Just kind of blank, mostly.
Do you feel anxious or nervous when you're unable to make decisions or take action at work?
I don't know... I don't think I feel nervous, exactly. It's more like... I just can't do it. I just sit there.
Have you been feeling sad or empty inside recently?
I... I'm not sure. I guess empty might be the right word. I just don't really feel much of anything. It's just... quiet, I suppose.
Do you feel anxious when you are not at work?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I just... go home and stay there. It doesn't really feel any different.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
I don't really think about the future. There's just... nothing to think about, really. It's just more of the same, I guess.
Do you ever worry about things in general?
I don't know. Not really. I just... I don't really care enough to worry, I think.
Do you feel anxious when you're doing everyday activities, like grocery shopping or meeting friends?
I don't... I don't really see friends anymore. And shopping is... I don't know. I just get it over with. I wouldn't say I feel anxious about it.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things for a long time?
No, I don't think so. I don't really... dwell on things. Like I said, I just don't have the energy to care that much.
Do you feel nervous when you're around other people?
Not really. I just... I don't really want to be around them. It's not that I'm nervous, I just... prefer to be alone, I guess.
Do you enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?

Not really. I just... I don't do much anymore. My printer for miniatures has just been sitting there with the same half-finished figure for months. And... I don't know, even things like yoga or walking in the woods... it just feels like another task to get through. It's not really something I actually want to do.
Do you feel anxious when you have to interact with coworkers or people at work?
No. Um... I just do my job. I don't really talk to them much unless I need to for a project or something. I'm not anxious about it, I just... keep to myself.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things for more than a few days at a time?
No. I mean... I don't really worry about much. I just... I don't have the energy for it.
Do you feel anxious when meeting new people or in social situations outside of work?
No, not really. I just... I don't really go out to meet people anyway. So, it's not really an issue.
Do you take pleasure in anything at all?

No... not really. Um... I used to print miniatures, but the printer has just been sitting there with a half-finished figure on it for months. I don't really care to finish it. And... I used to like yoga, or just walking in the woods, but now it just feels like... another chore. Like a task I have to get through, not something I want to do. So I just don't.
Do you feel anxious about anything at all in your daily life?
No, not really. I just... I don't feel much of anything. Just empty, I guess.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really been paying attention to it, but... my clothes fit the same, I guess. So, probably not.
Do you feel anxious when you think about your current situation or the fact that you can't seem to make decisions or take action?
Not really. I just... try not to think about it too much. It's just how things are right now, I guess.
Do you feel anxious when you are alone with your thoughts?
No... not anxious. It's mostly just... quiet. I just sit there, I guess.
Have you had a period of two weeks or more where you felt depressed or lost interest in most activities?

Yeah... I guess it's been longer than that. I just... haven't really felt like doing much. My printer for miniatures has been sitting with the same half-finished figure for months. And... I don't know. Even yoga, or walking in the woods... it all just feels like another task. Not something I actually want to do.
